wiki.title: Vince Leach
wiki.extract: Venden "Vince" Leach is an American politician from Arizona. A Republican, he is a member of the Arizona State Senate since 2025, and previously from 2019 to 2023. From 2015 to 2019, he was a member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 11. Leach won the race for Arizona State Senate from Legislative District 17 in the 2024 Arizona Senate election, defeating incumbent Justine Wadsack who defeated Leach in the 2022 Republican primary.
